fields.name: id
fields.description: Shop (seller) ID, i.e., the sellerId returned by other Nexscope Ozon tools; negative values are Ozon platform self-operated sellers (e.g., -2 Ozon Express, -4 Ozon Fresh), positive values are third-party sellers

fields.name: page.pageSize
fields.description: Items per page, default 20, maximum 20 (exceeding returns errcode 1002)

fields.name: page.orders
fields.description: Sort rules, elements {field, direction}; direction takes DESC (descending) / ASC (ascending). Common sort fields: sales, price, reviewRating, upTime

fields.name: memberId
fields.description: Member ID (a unique member identifier; a user can belong to multiple teams; data is attributed to memberId, max 1000)
